backup.title: Key backup
backup.warningMessage: If you do not set a recovery password, all old messages will become impossible to decrypt when you log in on a new device, change your browser, or clear your cache.
backup.warningNoRecovery: The password cannot be recovered. If you forget it, your encrypted messages are lost forever.
backup.needLocalKey: You need to have your local encryption key to manage the backup. If you are on a new device, use the recovery prompt instead.
backup.doneEnabled: Your recovery backup has been saved on the server.
backup.doneDisabled: Your recovery backup has been removed.
backup.recoveryPrompt: This account's messages are encrypted with a key that is not on this device. Enter your recovery password to restore access to your old messages.
backup.recoveryWrongPassword: Wrong password. The keys could not be recovered.
backup.multiDeviceTitle: A key from another device is required
backup.multiDevicePrompt: This account has other active devices, but this device has no encryption key and no backup.
backup.multiDeviceWarning: Creating a new key here would make the other devices unable to read new messages.
backup.multiDeviceAdvice: Open the app on another device, enable the key backup, then return here. If you cannot access the other devices, sign out everywhere to create a new key; old history will stay unreadable.
backup.newKeyPrompt: This device has no encryption key and no backup.
backup.newKeyWarning: A new key cannot decrypt the old history. This cannot be undone.
backup.newKeyAdvice: If another device still has the key, enable its backup and recover there first. Continue only if you accept losing access to old messages.
